title: Adequacy radii for stepped-wedge trials with time-varying effects
abstract: arXiv:2610.35853v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Complete stepped-wedge designs guarantee eventual intervention delivery, but their final periods contain no concurrent controls. Under exposure-time heterogeneity this creates a design-analysis tension: a constant-effect analysis can be precise while targeting a design-dependent contrast, whereas an exposure-time indicator (ETI) analysis targets a prespecified time-averaged effect but may be much less precise. We develop an adequacy radius that quantifies the size of exposure-time heterogeneity compatible with a prespecified tolerance for estimand mismatch, and combine it with precision calculations to compare complete wedges with rollout-constrained hybrid designs that retain a wait-list arm. translated_title: 针对具有时变效应的阶梯楔形试验的充分性半径
translated_abstract: 完整阶梯楔形设计保证干预最终能够实施，但其最后阶段不再包含同期对照组。在暴露时间异质性存在的情况下，这造成了设计与分析之间的张力：常数效应分析虽然可以达到较高精度，但其针对的是依赖于设计的对比；而暴露时间指示变量（ETI）分析虽然针对预先设定的时均效应，但精度可能大幅降低。我们提出了一个充分性半径，用于量化与预先设定的估计量失配容差相兼容的暴露时间异质性大小，并将其与精度计算相结合，以比较完整楔形设计与保留候补名单组的受推广约束的混合设计。在Hussey-Hughes模型下，对于带候补名单的平衡楔形设计，候补名单比例和相关性通过一个标量作用于常数效应GLS估计量；我们证明该半径随候补名单比例严格增加，并且……
tldr: 本文提出“充分性半径”来量化阶梯楔形试验中可容忍的暴露时间异质性程度，并证明保留候补名单组的混合设计能严格扩大这一容忍范围，从而在估计精度与估计目标之间实现更好的平衡。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an "adequacy radius" to quantify the tolerable extent of exposure-time heterogeneity in stepped-wedge trials and proves that hybrid designs retaining a wait-list arm strictly widen this tolerance, balancing precision against estimand mismatch.
